# main

> An always-on glass-morphism Windows overlay for gaming and power users. Spotify with synced lyrics, live performance monitoring, one-click FPS tweaks, quick launch, and 19 mini widgets. One-time $5 lifetime license — no subscription.

main runs from the system tray as a lightweight, always-on overlay on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). It's built by an indie developer (ryota) and sold as a single one-time purchase via PayPal; a unique license key is provisioned to the buyer's account instantly and is tied to their Google sign-in (not a device), so it survives reinstalls and new PCs.

## Core features

- Spotify integration via secure PKCE OAuth (your password never touches main) with live, time-synced lyrics from lrclib.net
- Real-time system performance monitoring — CPU, RAM, and FPS
- One-click FPS optimization engine that applies safe Windows system tweaks
- Quick Notes with persistent local storage
- App launcher for custom executables with custom icons
- Weather widget (wttr.in + geolocation)
- System-wide global hotkeys for media control
- A Widget Library of 19 mini widgets, all included in the base price
- Fully animated glass-morphism UI, runs in the background from the system tray

## Purchasing & licensing

- Price: one-time $5 USD, lifetime license — no subscription
- Payment: secure checkout via PayPal; license key issued instantly on payment
- Sign-in: Google account (the license is bound to the account, not the hardware)
- Refunds: digital product, so sales are generally final, but a refund is available within 14 days if it can't be made to work — see the Terms
- Supported OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit
- Includes free updates for the entire v3.x line

## Notes

- main is not affiliated with Spotify, Discord, or Microsoft.
- Some features automate your own Windows (media keys, overlays, macros, virtual controller input). Most are harmless, but certain anti-cheat systems dislike overlays or virtual input — use those specific features at your own discretion.
